status.title: Duty status
status.empty: There are no rosters you can see.
status.emptyCanEdit: Add a roster in [Edit duty rosters].

edit.title: Edit duty rosters
edit.noDepartment: There is no roster you can edit.
edit.conflict: Someone else changed it first. It has been reloaded; check it and edit again.
edit.gone: The roster was deleted or you can no longer edit it. The list has been reloaded.

roster.title: Rosters
roster.addHelp: Add rotation rules (weekday or shift rules) in the Rotation rules tab after creating the roster.
roster.name: Roster name
roster.deleteMessage: All of its rotation rules, placements, holidays, shared departments and assignees will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
roster.empty: No roster is assigned to you.
roster.emptyManage: No rosters yet. Use [Add roster] to create one.

rules.help: A roster can have several rules (in creation order). Every rule that applies on a day places its people, and the duty status shows only the people, not rule names. Editing a rule does not change existing placements; fill the month again to change them.

kindHelp.WEEKDAY: Places one person per applicable day in order. (e.g. Weekdays, Weekends & holidays)
kindHelp.SHIFT: Each person advances through a pattern of shift types (e.g. D-N-O-O).

rules.kindFixed: The type cannot be changed after the rule is created.
rules.name: Rule name
rules.nameHelp: 1-30 characters, unique within this roster. The name is shown only on this edit screen.
rules.daysEmpty: Choose at least one applicable day.
rules.membersHelp: Select active people in the org chart below and set the order with up/down. Deactivated people may stay but are skipped when filling a month.
rules.shiftAddHelp: After creating a shift rule, open [Show shift settings] to set its shift types, pattern, days, people and start cells.
rules.empty: No rules yet. Use [Add rule] to create one.
rules.deleteMessage: Placements of this rule from tomorrow on are deleted. Placements up to today remain.

shift.offHelp: "Off" (비) always exists and is not shown in the duty status. Shift types used in the pattern or placements cannot be deleted.
shift.typeHelp: Name 1-30 characters, short label 1-2 characters, both unique within the rule. "비번" and "비" are reserved for off duty.
shift.noTypesHelp: Add shift types first to choose them in cells.
shift.startCellOut: A start cell is outside the pattern. Choose it again.
shift.saveHelp: Existing placements stay as they are until you fill the month again.

placement.help: Select cells, then press a button below. Swapping takes two cells of the same rule. Past days can also be edited.
placement.noRules: There are no rules. Create one in the Rotation rules tab.
placement.sameRuleOnly: Swapping takes two seats of the same rule.
placement.filledSkipped: The month was filled. Skipped rules: {list}

skip.NO_APPLY_DAY: no applicable day in the month

fill.title: Fill month
fill.help: Every rotation rule of this roster fills the chosen month from today on. Existing placements of the rule in that period (including manual ones and ones on non-applicable days) are deleted and filled again; past days are not filled.

skip.NO_APPLY_DAY: no applicable day in the month

fill.rulePreview: Places on {place} day(s) and overwrites {overwrite} day(s) that had placements.
fill.noRules: There are no rules. Create one in the Rotation rules tab.
fill.nothing: No rule can be filled (all are skipped).
fill.overwriteDays: Deletes the placements on {count} day(s) and fills them again.
fill.noOverwrite: There are no placements to overwrite.
fill.emptyHolidayDays: Days left empty because there is no "Holiday" rule: {dates}
fill.mismatches: Days where the computed headcount differs from the set headcount:
fill.inactiveSlots: Cells left empty by deactivated people:

holiday.help: System holidays were copied when the roster was created. Days treated as Saturday or Sunday go to rules with that day, and days treated as holidays go to rules with "Holiday". Excluded days are treated as normal days. Changes do not alter existing placements or the calendar's red days.
holiday.addHelp: Add temporary holidays and the like. The same date cannot be added twice.
holiday.name: Name

share.help: Members of the roster's department (excluding sub-departments) see it. Members of shared departments also see it, and with "Include sub-departments" on, their sub-departments too.

assignee.help: Assignees edit this roster's rotation rules, month fills, manual changes, holidays and shared departments. Only active people in the department and its sub-departments can be chosen; the assignment ends on transfer, department move or account deactivation.

calendar.title: Duty calendar
calendar.emptyMonth: No duties to show this month.
